status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, event, at, state, reason) :-
status_reading_time_unknown(tenant, delivery, step, run, event, state, reason) :-
latest = max time : { status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, _, _, _, _) }.
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason) :-
status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, _, _, state, reason).
// A reading whose event instant is unknown can still disagree with the latest comparable reading
// or with another reading whose event instant is unknown.
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason) :-
status_reading_time_unknown(tenant, delivery, step, run, _, state, reason).
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason),
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, other, _), state != other.
status_conflict(tenant, delivery, step, run) :- status_disagreement(tenant, delivery, step, run, _).
current_delivery_status(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason) :-
status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, _, _, state, reason),
current_delivery_status(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason) :-
status_reading_time_unknown(tenant, delivery, step, run, _, state, reason),
// Delivery waiting time and completion time (decisions/delivery-commit-status.md).
// The end of the waiting interval is the earliest dated done reading of the same run, else the latest sweep
// of that run. The start is the latest dated waiting reading at or before that end. No waiting reading gives
.decl delivery_done_reading(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, time: number, at: symbol)
.decl delivery_waiting_reading(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, time: number)
.decl delivery_done_earliest(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, time: number)
.decl delivery_completed_at(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, at: symbol)
.decl delivery_has_done(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol)
.decl delivery_waiting_end(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, time: number)
.decl delivery_waiting_before_end(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, time: number)
.decl delivery_waiting_start(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, time: number)
.decl delivery_waiting_time(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, elapsed: number)
delivery_done_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, at) :-
earliest = min time : { delivery_done_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, _) }.
delivery_done_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, at).
start_time = max time : { delivery_waiting_before_end(tenant, delivery, step, run, time) }.
